title: Cerebus Jaka’s Story 15 Comic Book - #128 - November 1989 - Aardvark-Vanaheim
descriptionText: The product is a vintage comic book from November 1989, issue number 15 in the Cerebus series by Aardvark-Vanaheim. This comic falls under the genre of comics and is part of the US Comics tradition, specifically from the Copper Age era. The story likely features the character Cerebus and would be a valuable addition to any comic book collector's library.
